text: [Image #1] promissing. thats the city, so the map renders if all other systems dont, but they likely will, since the rest is literally just building out the browser js for what the physics are and how that decoded data affects the system and etc.
resolution: Acknowledged the browser Three.js loader proof: the compiled gamefile data reconstructs the HMSC city in a separate renderer, validating the loader thesis. Clarified that physics/interactions are now browser-runtime work over already decoded colliders, physics config, materials, and systems data rather than a new content format.
